The greater the upside to capex, the lower the forward estimates to free cash flow.

raw.text: SACRAMENTO, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SPACCircle Acquisition Corp. (the “Company”) announced the pricing of its initial public offering of 10,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit. The units will be listed on the Nasdaq Global Market (“Nasdaq”) under the symbol “SCQCU” commencing today. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share of the Company, one redeemable warrant, entitling the holder thereof to purchase one Class A ordinary share of the Company at an exercise price of $11.50 per share and one right to receive one half (1/2) of one Class A ordinary share upon the consummation of an initial business combination. The offering is expected to close on October 28, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions.

raw.title: Revolution Medicines Presents Overall Survival Data for RASONQUE™ (daraxonrasib) Across Subgroups in Previously Treated Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer at ESMO 2026
raw.text: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Revolution Medicines, Inc. (Nasdaq: RVMD), a global, commercial-stage oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers, today announced that exploratory subgroup analyses from the Phase 3 RASolute 302 trial were presented as a late-breaking abstract at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain. The analyses showed that RASONQUE (daraxonrasib) consistently provided an overall survival (OS) benefit compared with chemotherapy across all evaluated RAS genotype subgroups among patients with previously treated metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC), including those with no identified tumor RAS mutation. The OS benefit with RASONQUE was also maintained across preselected standard-of-care (SOC) chemotherapy regimens and prior treatment settings, including early metastatic recurrence following perioperative therapy.

("Celsius" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: CELH) and certain officers.   The class action, filed in the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida, and docketed under 26-cv-62465, is on behalf of a class consisting of all persons and entities other than Defendants that purchased or otherwise acquired Celsius securities between February 21, 2025 and June 3, 2026, both dates inclusive (the "Class Period"), seeking to recover damages caused by Defendants' violations of the federal securities laws and to pursue remedies under Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Rule 10b-5 promulgated thereunder, against the Company and certain of its top officials.

raw.title: Repligen Announces $1 Billion Private Convertible Senior Notes Transaction
raw.text: WALTHAM, Mass., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN) (“Repligen”), today announced that it entered into privately negotiated exchange and/or subscription agreements with certain holders of its outstanding 1.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2028 (the “2028 Notes”) and certain new investors, pursuant to which Repligen will issue $1.0 billion aggregate principal amount of 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 (the “New Notes”). Approximately $541.4 million principal amount of the New Notes will be issued in exchange for approximately $456.8 million principal amount of 2028 Notes (the “Exchange Transactions”) and approximately $458.6 million principal amount of the New Notes will be issued for cash (the “Subscription Transactions”, and together with the Exchange Transactions, the “Transactions”). The conversion price for the New Notes will initially be approximately $226.37 per share of Repligen's common stock, which represents a conversion premium of approximately 20% over the closing price of Repligen's common stock on October 29, 2026, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments. Following the closing of the Transactions, which is expected to occur on or about November 6, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, approximately $143.2 million in aggregate principal amount of 2028 Notes will remain outstanding with terms unchanged.

raw.text: JACKSONVILLE, Fla., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Landstar System, Inc. (NASDAQ: LSTR) (“Landstar” or the “Company”) today reported its financial results for the 2026 third quarter. The Company reported total revenue of $1.512 billion in the 2026 third quarter, an increase of 25% as compared to revenue of $1.205 billion in the 2025 third quarter, and basic and diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) of $1.42 in the 2026 third quarter, an increase of 154% as compared to EPS of $0.56 in the 2025 third quarter. It should be noted that EPS in the 2025 third quarter was negatively impacted by non-cash impairment charges of $30.1 million, or $0.66 per share, related to the previously disclosed strategic review of operations conducted during the 2025 third quarter, and, as further described below, the 2026 third quarter EPS was negatively impacted by highly elevated insurance and claim costs. The Company also reported a 14% increase in gross profit and a 25% increase in variable contribution (defined as revenue less the cost of purchased transportation and commissions to agents) in the 2026 third quarter, as compared in each case to the 2025 third quarter.

raw.title: Denali Therapeutics Receives 2026 Prix Galien USA Award for AVLAYAH® (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) as Best Biotechnology Product
raw.text: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Denali Therapeutics Inc. (Nasdaq: DNLI) today announced that AVLAYAH® (tividenofusp alfa-eknm) has been recognized as the “Best Biotechnology Product” of 2026 by The Galien Foundation. AVLAYAH is the first biologic approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) that is specifically designed to cross the blood-brain barrier and reach the whole body, including the brain. AVLAYAH is an enzyme replacement therapy that received FDA accelerated approval in March 2026 for the treatment of neurologic manifestations of a rare neurodegenerative disease called Hunter syndrome (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, or MPS II) when initiated in presymptomatic or symptomatic pediatric patients weighing at least 5 kg prior to advanced neurologic impairment. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification of clinical benefit in a confirmatory study.

raw.title: Rapport Announces Pricing of Underwritten Offerings of Common Stock and Pre-Funded Warrants and Convertible Notes and Concurrent Private Placement
raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced the pricing of separate underwritten public offerings of approximately $175.0 million of shares of its common stock at an offering price of $21.00 per share (the “Offering Price”) and, in lieu of common stock to investors that so choose, pre-funded warrants to purchase up to approximately $25.0 million of shares of its common stock at an offering price of $20.999 per pre-funded warrant, which represents the per share Offering Price less the $0.001 per share exercise price for each pre-funded warrant (the “common stock offering”) and $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of 2.25% convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes”) (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport entered into a share purchase agreement with a certain investor (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport agreed to offer and sell, and the Investor agreed to purchase, approximately $30.0 million of shares of Rapport's common stock, at the Offering Price. The sale of shares to the Investor in the concurrent private placement will not be registered as part of the common stock offering.

raw.title: Rapport Announces Proposed Public Offerings of Common Stock and Convertible Notes as well as Concurrent Private Placement
raw.text: BOSTON and SAN DIEGO, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Rapport Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: RAPP) (“Rapport” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to the discovery and development of small molecule precision medicines for patients with neurological or psychiatric disorders, today announced that it has commenced separate underwritten public offerings of $200.0 million of shares of its common stock (the “common stock offering”) and $150.0 million aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2032 (the “notes offering” and together with the common stock offering, the “underwritten offerings”). In addition, Rapport intends to grant the underwriters in the common stock offering a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $30.0 million of shares of its common stock under the same terms and conditions and intends to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $22.5 million aggregate principal amount of notes solely to cover over-allotments, if any. Concurrently with the underwritten offerings, Rapport intends to enter into a share purchase agreement with a certain investor named therein (the “Investor”), in a separately negotiated transaction (the “concurrent private placement” and together with the underwritten offerings, the “offerings”) pursuant to which Rapport intends to offer and sell, and the Investor intends to purchase shares of Rapport's common stock at the price per share of common stock in the common stock offering. The sale of shares to the Investor in the proposed concurrent private placement will not be registered as part of the common stock offering. The proposed offerings are subject to market and other conditions, and there can be no assurance as to whether or when the offerings may be completed, or as to the actual size or terms of the offerings.

raw.title: Phathom Pharmaceuticals Provides Update on FDA Litigation
raw.text: FLORHAM PARK, N.J., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phathom Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: PHAT), a biopharmaceutical company focused on commercializing and developing novel treatments for gastrointestinal (GI) diseases, today announced the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's (FDA's) establishment of a public docket (Docket No. FDA-2026-N-13038) to solicit comment on legal and regulatory questions regarding certain issues raised by a filer of an abbreviated new drug application (ANDA) referencing VOQUEZNA® (vonoprazan) tablets, BDR Pharmaceuticals, International Pvt. Ltd. (BDR), in litigation brought against the FDA following FDA's rejection of the ANDA. The litigation was brought to challenge FDA's June 6, 2025 decision granting Phathom's Citizen Petition, which agreed with Phathom that VOQUEZNA benefits from 10 years of New Chemical Entity (NCE) exclusivity through May 3, 2032. The deadline for comments submitted to the public docket is November 23, 2026.

raw.title: Phathom Pharmaceuticals Provides Update on Litigation Filed by BDR Pharmaceuticals against FDA
raw.text: FLORHAM PARK, N.J., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phathom Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: PHAT), a biopharmaceutical company focused on commercializing and developing novel treatments for gastrointestinal (GI) diseases, announced today that BDR Pharmaceuticals International Pvt. Ltd. (BDR) has filed suit against the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and related Federal Defendants in the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, principally challenging FDA's alleged refusal to receive an abbreviated new drug application (ANDA) referencing Phathom's new drug application (NDA) for VOQUEZNA®. In the suit, BDR alleges that FDA has improperly applied the GAIN Act to extend Phathom's New Chemical Entity (NCE) exclusivity for VOQUEZNA (vonoprazan fumarate) tablets. Phathom is evaluating the BDR filings, but believes that FDA carefully and correctly evaluated this issue in its June 6, 2025 grant of Phathom's December 11, 2024 Citizen Petition, in which FDA recognized 10 years of NCE exclusivity for VOQUEZNA tablets through May 3, 2032. Phathom intends to take appropriate action to protect its statutory exclusivities.

raw.text: New York, NY, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Chaince Securities, LLC (“Chaince”), a FINRA-registered broker-dealer and wholly owned subsidiary of Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: CD), today announced that it has been engaged as the exclusive sales agent for the at-the-market (“ATM”) equity offering program of Solowin Holdings (NASDAQ: AXG) (the “Company”), a Cayman Islands-incorporated holding company headquartered in Hong Kong whose operations are conducted through its operating subsidiaries and whose offerings span regulated stablecoin issuance and payments, asset tokenization, securities trading and asset management, and AI-powered enterprise services. The Company and Chaince entered into an At Market Sales Agreement, dated October 22, 2026 (the “Sales Agreement”), under which the Company may offer and sell, from time to time, Class A ordinary shares of the Company (the “Class A Ordinary Shares”) having an aggregate offering price of up to US$50 million through Chaince, as the sales agent.

raw.text: LEXINGTON, Mass., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Voyager Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: VYGR), a biotechnology company dedicated to leveraging genetics to treat neurological diseases, today announced two poster presentations at the upcoming 19th Clinical Trials on Alzheimer's Disease (CTAD) Conference taking place in Boston, November 16-19, 2026. raw.title: Tibooburra Project Update: RC drilling to commence as Novo forms unincorporated Joint Venture with Manhattan Gold
raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Novo has now received all regulatory and land holder approvals required to commence a ~2,700 m RC program at Tibooburra, NSW, with drilling at the Clone prospect currently anticipated to commence in early-November 2026.  Step out drilling at the Clone prospect will target a northern extension to open, shallowly plunging, high-grade gold mineralisation confirmed during Novo's 2025 drill campaign that reported results up to 12 m @ 5.90 g/t Au from 16 m, including 5 m @ 13.74 g/t Au from 23 m in TBR0001.1   Regional streams and targeted soils, mapping and rock chip sampling commenced at Tibooburra in September 2026, with results pending and a further program being undertaken in October 2026.

raw.title: 49North Signs MOU with UNWAVE for Joint Production and Support of Counter-UAS Systems
raw.text: Brings Canadian defence integration and sustainment expertise to partnership with Ukrainian counter-drone manufacturer OTTAWA, ON, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- 49North, a wholly owned subsidiary of MDA Space Ltd. (TSX: MDA) (NYSE: MDA), announced today that it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with UNWAVE, a Ukrainian counter-drone technology manufacturer, to collaborate on the joint production and support of counter-uncrewed aerial systems (C-UAS).

raw.title: Co-Diagnostics' Joint Venture CoSara Diagnostics Completes Clinical Study and Regulatory Submission for Point-of-Care Tuberculosis Test, Sets Stage for Commercial Launch in India
raw.text: CDSCO Clearance and Commercial Launch in India Anticipated Before Year-End 2026 Study Demonstrated 97.3% Sensitivity and 96.0% Specificity Consistent Performance Across Three Test Batches Integrated Mobile and Cloud Infrastructure Already Deployed in India to Support AnticipatedCommercial Launch SALT LAKE CITY, Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Co-Diagnostics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CODX) ("Co-Dx" or "the Company"), a molecular diagnostics company with a unique, patented platform for the development of molecular diagnostic tests, today announced that CoSara Diagnostics Pvt. Ltd. ("CoSara"), the Company's joint venture in India, has completed its clinical performance study of the CoSara PCR Mycobacterium tuberculosis ("MTB" or "TB") test on the CoSara PCR Pro® instrument* and has submitted the test to India's Central Drugs Standard Control Organization ("CDSCO") for regulatory clearance.

raw.text: SP Media Has Made a Significant Capital Investment to Co-invest into New Businesses that Expand Lionsgate's Global Platform  Deal Includes Partnership on Independent Feature Film Production and Extends Resources toward the Continuing Diversification of 3 Arts and Other Lionsgate Businesses SANTA MONICA, Calif., Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) and SP Media, led by longtime producer, financier and entrepreneur Steven Paul, today announced the formation of a joint venture through which SP Media will make a significant capital investment to co-invest in new ventures that expand and grow the Lionsgate platform as well as extending resources toward the continuing diversification of 3 Arts and other Lionsgate businesses.

raw.title: Stockholders of Sunrise Realty Trust, a Tannenbaum Capital Group Affiliate, Approve Merger-Related Proposal with Southern Realty Trust; Company Declares Stub Period Dividend
raw.text: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. (Nasdaq: SUNS) (“SUNS” or the “Company”), a lender on the Tannenbaum Capital Group (“TCG”) Real Estate platform, today announced that its stockholders approved the issuance of approximately 8,464,955 shares of SUNS common stock, subject to certain adjustments, in connection with the Company's previously announced merger with Southern Realty Trust Inc. (“SRT”) (the “Merger”) at the Company's special meeting of stockholders held earlier today (the “Special Meeting”). Approximately 59.5% of the outstanding shares of SUNS common stock were voted virtually or by proxy at the Special Meeting, and approximately 91.6% of the votes cast at the Special Meeting were voted in favor of the proposal. SRT stockholders also approved the Merger at its special meeting held earlier today. The approvals represent a key milestone toward combining SUNS and SRT into a larger, more efficient Nasdaq-listed commercial real estate lending platform.

raw.title: Zentalis Pharmaceuticals Announces Meaningful Median Overall Survival Data in Cyclin E1-Positive Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer from DENALI Part 1b to be Presented at the ESMO Congress 2026
raw.text: SAN DIEGO, Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zentalis® Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZNTL), a clinical oncology innovator advancing late-stage development of investigational first-in-class WEE1 inhibitor azenosertib as a biomarker-driven treatment approach for ovarian cancer, today presented results from an interim analysis of the DENALI Part 1b study (GOG-3066) as of a May 22, 2026 data cutoff, including the first overall survival analysis for azenosertib, at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain.

(NASDAQ: IOVA), a commercial biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and delivering novel polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with cancer, today announced that one-time lifileucel monotherapy demonstrated unprecedented efficacy with deep, durable responses across two difficult-to-treat soft tissue sarcomas with limited treatment options, metastatic UPS and DDLPS, in a pilot trial presented orally at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain. Among the first eight evaluable patients, physician-assessed confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50%.

raw.title: Iovance Presents New Data at ESMO 2026 Demonstrating Deep, Durable Responses with Lifileucel TIL Cell Therapy Plus Pembrolizumab in Frontline Advanced Melanoma
raw.text: 62.5% Confirmed Objective Response Rate (ORR) and 29.2% Complete Response (CR) Rate in Final Phase 2 Analysis Median Overall Survival (OS) Not Reached at More than 4 Years of Median Follow-up Oral Presentation at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026 Reinforces Ongoing TILVANCE-301 Phase 3 Trial PHILADELPHIA and MADRID, Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: IOVA), a commercial biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and delivering novel polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapies for patients with cancer, today announced that one-time lifileucel combined with pembrolizumab demonstrated a 62.5% ORR and a 29.2% CR rate, with median OS not reached at 50.9 months of median study follow-up in the final Phase 2 analysis in frontline advanced melanoma. The Phase 2 results were presented on October 23, 2026 in a Proffered Paper oral session at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain.

raw.text: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bolt Biotherapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: BOLT) (“Bolt” or the “Company”) today announced the acquisition of Prana Therapies, Inc. (“Prana”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering next-generation half-life-extended multispecific antibodies designed to deliver best-in-disease therapies. Following the acquisition, the Company will focus on advancing Prana's pipeline of half-life-extended multispecific antibodies generated from its proprietary INSPIRE platform, led by PRA-216, a novel IL-4Rα/TSLP bispecific antibody currently in Phase 2 development in asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and atopic dermatitis, with a Phase 2 study in eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) planned.

(NASDAQ: NCPL) ("Netcapital" or the "Company") between December 15, 2021 and September 3, 2026, both dates inclusive (the Class Period). raw.text: WASHINGTON, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: SXTP; SXTPW) (the “Company”), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing new medicines for vector-borne diseases, today announced expansion of its vector-borne disease research portfolio through a sponsored research agreement with The University of Southern Mississippi (USM) to assess the therapeutic potential of castanospermine—a naturally occurring iminosugar derived from the Australian Chestnut (Castanospermum australe)—in nonclinical models of alpha-gal syndrome (AGS). raw.text: –  Etentamig is a second-generation BCMA-directed bispecific antibody T-cell engager with a clinical profile and dosing schedule that can potentially support treatment across a broad range of settings, including in community-based care –  In the Phase 3 CERVINO study, etentamig achieved statistically significant improvements in overall response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS) versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies –  Submission underscores AbbVie's ambition to advance a broad multiple myeloma portfolio that addresses disease complexity and supports patients' evolving care goals  NORTH CHICAGO, Ill., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced the submission of a Biologics License Application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for etentamig, a second-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody T-cell engager administered intravenously for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.1 BCMA-directed bispecific antibodies and CAR-T therapies have significantly changed the treatment landscape for people living with multiple myeloma.2 However, their broader adoption may be limited by adverse events such as cytokine release syndrome, infections or neurotoxicity, as well as specialized administration and monitoring requirements.2,3,4 Additionally, as disease relapses, treatment options in later lines of therapy become increasingly limited.

raw.title: AbbVie Submits Biologics License Application (BLA) for Etentamig to U.S. FDA for Adults Living With Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma
raw.text: –  Etentamig is a second-generation BCMA-directed bispecific antibody T-cell engager with a clinical profile and dosing schedule that can potentially support treatment across a broad range of settings, including in community-based care –  In the Phase 3 CERVINO study, etentamig achieved statistically significant improvements in overall response rate (ORR) and progression-free survival (PFS) versus investigator's choice of standard available therapies –  Submission underscores AbbVie's ambition to advance a broad multiple myeloma portfolio that addresses disease complexity and supports patients' evolving care goals  NORTH CHICAGO, Ill., Oct. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) today announced the submission of a Biologics License Application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for etentamig, a second-generation BCMA x CD3 bispecific antibody T-cell engager administered intravenously for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.1 BCMA-directed bispecific antibodies and CAR-T therapies have significantly changed the treatment landscape for people living with multiple myeloma.2 However, their broader adoption may be limited by adverse events such as cytokine release syndrome, infections or neurotoxicity, as well as specialized administration and monitoring requirements.2,3,4 Additionally, as disease relapses, treatment options in later lines of therapy become increasingly limited.

raw.title: Flotek Receives EPA Approval For VeraCAL Flare Monitoring At Petroleum Refineries
raw.text: HOUSTON, Oct. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Flotek Industries, Inc. ("Flotek" or the "Company") (NYSE: FTK) today announced that the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency ("EPA") has approved its proprietary VeraCAL optical system as an alternative to gas chromatography for measuring flare vent gas composition and net heating value ("NHV") under 40 CFR Part 63, Subpart CC, National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants From Petroleum Refineries ("MACT CC"). The Company believes the approval positions its Data Analytics business to serve petroleum refinery compliance monitoring, a significant new opportunity for VeraCAL.

raw.text: WALTHAM, Mass., Oct. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Werewolf Therapeutics, Inc. (the “Company” or “Werewolf”) (Nasdaq: HOWL), an innovative biopharmaceutical company pioneering the development of conditionally activated therapeutics engineered to stimulate the body's immune system for the treatment of cancer, today announced that it has been selected for an oral presentation and will present two posters at the upcoming Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer's (SITC) 2026 Annual Meeting, taking place November 4-8, 2026, in Phoenix, Arizona.

raw.title: Candel Therapeutics Announces Late-Breaking Abstract Accepted for Poster Presentation at the SITC 2026 Annual Meeting, Featuring Aglatimagene Besadenovec Data in Localized Prostate Cancer
raw.text: NEEDHAM, Mass., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Candel Therapeutics, Inc. (Candel or the Company) (Nasdaq: CADL), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing multimodal immunotherapies to improve disease outcomes for patients with cancer, today announced that a late-breaking abstract from its phase 2 PrTK05 clinical trial evaluating aglatimagene besadenovec (aglatimagene) in localized prostate cancer has been accepted for poster presentation at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer's (SITC) 41st Annual Meeting, taking place November 4–8, 2026, in Phoenix, Arizona.

(Nasdaq: ELTX) (“Elicio” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation immunotherapies for KRAS-driven cancers, today announced that the Company will conduct a keynote/plenary presentation, as well as two poster presentations showcasing additional results from the randomized Phase 2 AMPLIFY-7P study of camupepimut (ELI-002 7P) and an expanded antigen-agnostic intratumoral application of the AMP-adjuvant platform at the Society for Immunotherapy of Cancer's (“SITC”) Annual Meeting. The meeting will take place November 4-8, 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona.

The Auditor remains engaged, and the Company is working with the Auditor to complete the audit.

raw.title: Aeon Strategies Ltd. Announces Anticipated Late Filing of Annual Financial Statements and Application for Management Cease Trade Order
raw.text: TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - October 23, 202 6 - AEON STRATEGIES LTD. (formerly Cloud3 Ventures Inc.) (CSE: AEON) (OTCQB:CLDVF)(FSE:WQ40) (the “ Company ” or “ Aeon ”) announces that it expects to be unable to file its audited annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, the related management's discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certifications (collectively, the “ Annual Filings ”) by the October 28, 2026 filing deadline under Part 4 of National Instrument 51-102 – Continuous Disclosure Obligations and National Instrument 52-109 – Certification of Disclosure in Issuers' Annual and Interim Filings . The delay is due to (i) the limited availability of the Company's auditor, Davidson & Company LLP  (the “ Auditor ”); and (ii) the additional time required to complete audit procedures relating to the Company's crypto-related investments, which are more complex than in prior years. The Auditor remains engaged, and the Company is working with the Auditor to complete the audit. The Company has applied to the Ontario Securities Commission, as principal regulator, for a management cease trade order (the “ MCTO ”) under National Policy 12-203 – Management Cease Trade Orders (“ NP 12-203 ”) . If granted, the MCTO will prohibit the Company's Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer from trading in the Company's securities until the Annual Filings are filed and the MCTO is revoked. The MCTO generally will not affect the ability of other shareholders to trade in the Company's listed subordinate voting shares.

(CSE: AVE | FRA: C0O0 | OTC: VBAMF) (“Aventis” or the “Company”) is pleased to report preliminary results from the fall 2026 surface exploration program (the “Program”) at the Corvo Uranium Project (“Corvo” or the “Project”) in northern Saskatchewan (Please see Figure 1). The Program was funded by Aventis and carried out by Standard Uranium Ltd. (TSX-V: STND) (“Standard Uranium”), the operator of the Project, under the three-year earn-in option agreement between the two companies.

raw.text: BRISBANE, Australia, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- North American lithium producer Elevra Lithium Limited (“Elevra” or “Company”) (ASX:ELV; NASDAQ:ELVR) is pleased to announce that it has completed the sale of all of its rights and interests in the Ewoyaa Lithium Project (“Ewoyaa Project”) in Ghana to Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt Co., Ltd. (“Huayou”), as announced on 11 May 20261 and 1 October 20262.

raw.title: Westward Gold Announces Appointment of Mr. Andrew Lee to Board of Directors
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia, October 28, 2026 - TheNewswire – Westward Gold Inc. (CSE: WG, OTCQB: WGLIF, FSE: IM50) (“Westward” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Mr. Andrew Lee to the Company's Board of Directors, effective October 28, 2026. Mr. Lee will serve as Independent Director, replacing Mr. Allan Fabbro, who has acted in that role since June of 2023. Mr. Lee brings over 15 years of experience in mining finance, capital markets and strategy to Westward. He currently serves as Vice President, Finance at Wheaton Precious Metals Corp. (“Wheaton”), where he oversees corporate finance and treasury, and plays a key role in evaluating, structuring and executing streaming and royalty transactions and strategic investments. Prior to joining Wheaton in 2017, Mr. Lee held various positions at BHP Group in Singapore, focusing on global commodity markets and corporate strategy. He also serves as a director of Pacific Empire Minerals Corp. Mr. Lee holds a Master of Business Administration from Simon Fraser University and a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Mathematics and Economics from Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.

(TSX: WELL) ("WELL"), a digital healthcare company focused on positively impacting health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower healthcare practitioners and their patients globally, today announced that the Commissioner of Competition has concluded the Competition Bureau's review of WELL's acquisition of a majority interest in HEALWELL and has issued a No Action Letter. The No Action Letter, issued on October 22, 2026, confirms that the Commissioner does not, at this time, intend to make an application under section 92 of the Competition Act in respect of WELL's acquisition of a controlling interest in HEALWELL completed on April 1, 2025, including HEALWELL's concurrent acquisition of Orion Health (the "Transaction").

raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Westhaven Gold Corp. (TSX-V: WHN) (OTCQB: WTHVF) (FRA: 1W5) (“Westhaven” or the “Company”) is pleased to report the completion of 117-hole (37,242m) resource infill drilling program at the South Zone gold and silver deposit on the Shovelnose property in southern British Columbia. raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Zacatecas Silver Corp. (TSXV: ZAC | OTCQB: ZCTSF | FRA: 7TV) (“Zacatecas Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has received the drill permit for its Oso Negro gold-silver project (“Oso Negro” or the “Project”) in Sonora, Mexico, and has finalized a 2,500 metre maiden diamond drill program at the Prospecto and Tere vein systems. Surface access has been secured from the private landowner and the Project is drill-ready.

raw.title: Zacatecas Silver Reports High-Grade Gold and Silver Rock Chip Sampling at Cumaro, Sonora, with Assays up to 40.6 g/t Gold and 253 g/t Silver

raw.title: RecycLiCo and Alaska Energy Metals Collaborate to Test Proprietary Processing Methods on the Polymetallic Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. (“RecycLiCo”) (TSX.V: AMY | OTCQB: AMYZF | FSE: ID4), a critical mineral refining and lithium-ion battery upcycling company, and Alaska Energy Metals Corp. (“AEMC”) (TSX.V: AEMC | OTCQB: AKEMF | FRA: V7F) are pleased to announce the commencement of testing of metal concentrate samples derived from drill core from the 2023-2024 exploration campaigns at the polymetallic Eureka deposit, located at AEMC's Nikolai Nickel Project in Alaska. The work is being done at RecycLiCo's laboratory in Delta, BC, in accordance with a protocol prepared by RecycLiCo and approved by AEMC. Testing is in furtherance of the previously announced memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) between AEMC and RecycLiCo's U.S. subsidiary to assess the ways in which RecycLiCo's hydrometallurgical processing technology could be used in refining the output from the Eureka deposit, which contains seven U.S. Government-designated Critical Minerals, including nickel, cobalt, copper, chromium, platinum, palladium, and gold (along with the non-critical mainstay metal iron). Recently reported locked cycle flotation results have proven strong recoveries of metals reporting to a bulk nickel-copper concentrate. AEMC is exploring multiple avenues for hydrometallurgical testing to determine the optimum extraction technique to achieve the highest value from downstream processing of the bulk concentrate.

raw.text: MUNICH--(BUSINESS WIRE)--A steady climb to a new high: For the eighth consecutive year, Allianz is the world's most valuable insurance brand and has reached a record $30.7 billion in brand value, lifting it one place to No. 26 in Interbrand's Best Global Brands 2026 ranking. The upward trajectory is backed by strong business growth and financial perform.

raw.title: RecycLiCo and Alaska Energy Metals Collaborate to Test Proprietary Processing Methods on the Polymetallic Eureka Deposit, Nikolai Nickel Project, Alaska
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. (“RecycLiCo”) (TSX.V: AMY | OTCQB: AMYZF | FSE: ID4), a critical mineral refining and lithium-ion battery upcycling company, and Alaska Energy Metals Corp. (“AEMC”) (TSX.V: AEMC | OTCQB: AKEMF | FRA: V7F) are pleased to announce the commencement of testing of metal concentrate samples derived from drill core from the 2023-2024 exploration campaigns at the polymetallic Eureka deposit, located at AEMC's Nikolai Nickel Project in Alaska. The work is being done at RecycLiCo's laboratory in Delta, BC, in accordance with a protocol prepared by RecycLiCo and approved by AEMC. Testing is in furtherance of the previously announced memorandum of understanding (“MOU”) between AEMC and RecycLiCo's U.S. subsidiary to assess the ways in which RecycLiCo's hydrometallurgical processing technology could be used in refining the output from the Eureka deposit, which contains seven U.S. Government-designated Critical Minerals, including nickel, cobalt, copper, chromium, platinum, palladium, and gold (along with the non-critical mainstay metal iron). Recently reported locked cycle flotation results have proven strong recoveries of metals reporting to a bulk nickel-copper concentrate. AEMC is exploring multiple avenues for hydrometallurgical testing to determine the optimum extraction technique to achieve the highest value from downstream processing of the bulk concentrate.

raw.text: Company to host Q3 2026 results webinar on December 1, 2026   Varennes, Quebec, October 28, 2026 – TheNewswire - CHARBONE CORPORATION (TSXV: CH; OTCQB: CHHYF; FSE: K47) (“ CHARBONE ” or the “ Company ”), a vertically integrated industrial gases company focused on production, distribution and storage of clean ultra-high purity (“ UHP ”) hydrogen and other strategic industrial gases , today announced that preliminary gas income for the three-month period ending September 30, 2026 is expected to increase 21% to $0.55 million from gas income of $0.46 million for the prior three-month period ending June 30, 2026. raw.text: BOSTON, Oct. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Compass Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CMPX), a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company developing proprietary antibody-based therapeutics to treat multiple human diseases, today announced the publication of results from the positive Phase 2/3 COMPANION-002 study of tovecimig in combination with paclitaxel in patients with previously treated, advanced biliary tract cancer (BTC) in the Journal of Clinical Oncology (JCO). The results are also being presented today by Nilofer S. Azad, M.D., Johns Hopkins Sidney Kimmel Comprehensive Cancer Center, at the 2026 European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress in Madrid, Spain. The full publication is available via open access at https://ascopubs.org/toc/jco/0/ja.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. (TSXV: CTV) (OTCQB: CTVFF) ("CleanTech" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update with respect to the proposed sale of the Company's Robinson-Lasher zinc-germanium-gallium deposit (the "Robinson-Lasher Project") to Silver Elephant Mining Corp. ("Silver Elephant"), as previously disclosed in news releases dated June 12, 2026 and September 14, 2026 (the "Transaction"). Pursuant to the asset purchase agreement (the "Asset Purchase Agreement") entered into among the Company, Silver Elephant and U.S. Fluorspar LLC (the "Vendor" or "Subsidiary"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, Silver Elephant is required to pay to the Company an aggregate of US$1,255,000 in a series of cash payments as partial consideration for the purchase of the Robinson-Lasher Project, ending on or before September 1, 2029.

The company's Form 10-Q and earnings press release, along with the Third Quarter 2026 financial supplement and earnings presentation, are available now on the Investor Relations page of the company's website.

raw.title: Freddie Mac Sells $3.8 Million in Non-Performing Loans
raw.text: MCLEAN, Va., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Freddie Mac (OTCQB: FMCC) today announced it sold via auction 25 deeply delinquent non-performing residential first lien loans (NPLs) from its mortgage-related investments portfolio to Igloo Series VII Trust. The loans, with a balance of approximately $3.8 million, are currently serviced by Selene Finance LP. The sale is part of Freddie Mac's Extended Timeline Pool Offering (EXPO®) and the transaction is expected to settle in December 2026. Freddie Mac, through its advisors, began marketing the transaction on September 16, 2026, to potential bidders active in the NPL market.

raw.title: Freddie Mac Prices Approximately $243.4 Million SLST Securitization
raw.text: MCLEAN, Va., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Freddie Mac (OTCQB: FMCC) today announced the pricing of the Freddie Mac Seasoned Loans Structured Transaction Trust (SLST) Series 2026-1, a securitization of approximately $243.4 million including both guaranteed senior and non-guaranteed subordinate securities backed by a pool of seasoned residential mortgage loans. The SLST program is a fundamental part of Freddie Mac's seasoned loan offerings which reduce less-liquid assets in its mortgage-related investments portfolio and shed credit and market risk via economically reasonable transactions.

raw.title: GRG Resources Corp. Announces Binding Offer to Sell 1.5% NSR Royalty to Mogotes Metals for $13 Million
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - GRG Resources Corp. raw.title: Honey Badger Silver Announces Filing of NI 43-101 Technical Report for the PC Silver Mine Preliminary Economic Assessment
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 29, 2026) - Honey Badger Silver Inc. (TSXV: TUF) (OTCQB: HBEIF) (FSE: 1QA) (Tradegate: 1QA) ("Honey Badger Silver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has filed an independent technical report (the "Technical Report") prepared in accordance with National Instrument 43-101 - Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects ("NI 43-101"), supporting the previously announced Preliminary Economic Assessment (the "PEA") and updated Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") for its 100%-owned PC Silver Mine (Prairie Creek) in the Northwest Territories, Canada. The Technical Report, entitled "Preliminary Economic Assessment - PC Silver Mine - Northwest Territories", with an effective date of June 21, 2026, and was prepared by JDS Energy & Mining Inc. The Technical Report is available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca and on the Company's website at www.honeybadgersilver.com.

recentNews.title: HEALWELL and WELL Health Announce Competition Bureau has Concluded Its Merger Review and Issued a No Action Letter

raw.title: HEALWELL and WELL Health Announce Competition Bureau has Concluded Its Merger Review and Issued a No Action Letter
raw.text: Toronto, Ontario and Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 28, 2026) - HEALWELL AI Inc. (TSX: AIDX) (OTCQX: HWAIF) ("HEALWELL" or the "Company"), a healthcare artificial intelligence company focused on preventative care, and WELL Health Technologies Corp. (TSX: WELL) ("WELL"), a digital healthcare company focused on positively impacting health outcomes by leveraging technology to empower healthcare practitioners and their patients globally, today announced that the Commissioner of Competition has concluded the Competition Bureau's review of WELL's acquisition of a majority interest in HEALWELL and has issued a No Action Letter. The No Action Letter, issued on October 22, 2026, confirms that the Commissioner does not, at this time, intend to make an application under section 92 of the Competition Act in respect of WELL's acquisition of a controlling interest in HEALWELL completed on April 1, 2025, including HEALWELL's concurrent acquisition of Orion Health (the "Transaction").

recentNews.title: Headwater Gold Stakes the Ollie Epithermal Gold Project in Nevada's Walker Lane

raw.title: Headwater Gold Stakes the Ollie Epithermal Gold Project in Nevada's Walker Lane
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia - TheNewswire -  October 29, 2026: Headwater Gold Inc. (CSE: HWG) (OTCQX: HWAUF) (the “Company” or “Headwater”) is pleased to announce it has acquired 100% interest in the Ollie Project (“Ollie” or the “Project”) through claim staking in Mineral County, Nevada. The Project is located within the Walker Lane gold belt, approximately 5 kilometres (“km”) northeast of Fortitude Gold Corporation's Isabella Pearl mine and 3 km east-northeast of Lahontan Gold Corp.'s Santa Fe project. Headwater generated the Project through geological mapping, alteration analysis and surface sampling, identifying an untested opportunity for concealed gold mineralization within a large, well-endowed hydrothermal district.

raw.title: Japan Gold Announces Results of Annual General Meeting
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 23, 2026) - Japan Gold Corp. (TSXV: JG) (OTCQB: JGLDF) ("Japan Gold" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM), held on October 22, 2026, in Vancouver, British Columbia. All resolutions set out by the Company's Board of Directors and Management in the Company's Information Circular dated September 11, 2026, were approved by shareholders, including: To receive the annual financial statements of the Company for its fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, together with the report of the auditors thereon; To appoint Davidson & Company LLP, Chartered Professional Accountants, as the Company's auditor for the ensuing year and to authorize the directors to fix the auditor's remuneration; To fix the number of directors at seven (7); To elect directors for the ensuing year; To approve the continuation of the Company's 2023 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, as set out in the Company's Information Circular, in accordance with the requirements of the TSX Venture Exchange.

raw.text: October 30, 2026 – TheNewswire - Ottawa, Canada – Edgewater Wireless Systems Inc. (TSXV: YFI) (OTC: KPIFF) (“ Edgewater ” or the “ Company ”) announces that it will settle its obligation to pay an aggregate of $17,726.30 in interest as of December 1, 2025, $17,531.51 in interest as of March 1, 2026, $17,921.10 in interest as of June 1, 2026 and $17,921.10 in interest as of September 1, 2026 to the holders of its unsecured debentures issued September 1, 2022 (the “ Debentures ”) through the issuance of an aggregate of 1,421,982 common shares of the Company at a deemed price of $0.05 per share (the “ Shares ”). The Shares are issued in full satisfaction of the December 1, 2025, March 1, 2026, June 1, 2026 and September 1, 2026 interest payment obligations in accordance with the terms of the Debentures. The debt settlement is subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange.   Certain directors of the Company received an aggregate of 265,995 Shares and therefore the share issuance constitutes a “related party transaction” as that term is defined in Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions (“ MI 61-101 ”). The Company will rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 as neither the fair market value of the Shares nor the debt exceeds 25% of the Company's market capitalization .

raw.title: Li-FT Announces First Results from Summer Drill Program at the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project, Quebec
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li-FT Power Ltd. (“LIFT” or the “Company”) (TSXV: LIFT) (ASX: LFT) (OTCQX: LIFFF) (Frankfurt: WS0) is pleased to announce assay results from the first 5 of 45 drill holes from the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project (“AGLP”) in Québec, Canada (Figure 1). The intercepts for drill holes ALP-0001 to ALP-0005C are presented in Table 1 and shown in figures 2, 3 & 4, with a highlight of 56 meters of 1.43 % Li 2 O intersected in drillhole ALP002.

raw.text: TORONTO, Ontario — October 29, 2026 - TheNewswire — LAURION Mineral Exploration Inc. (TSX-V: LME | OTC: LMEFF | FSE: 5YD) (“LAURION” or the “Company”) is pleased to report assay results from drill holes LBX26-113, LBX26-114A, LBX26-115, LBX26-116, LBX26-117 and LBX26-121, from its 2026 Phase 1 diamond drilling program at its 100%-owned Ishkōday Gold and Polymetallic Project (“Ishkōday Project”), located approximately 220 km northeast of Thunder Bay and 28 km northeast of Beardmore, Northwestern Ontario. Building on the drilling program to date, LAURION increased its planned Phase 1 drilling from 3,865 metres to 5,605 metres across 22 drill holes. The expanded program is being informed by SRK Consulting's independent structural gap analysis of the A-Zone, which identified five priority target areas where additional drilling may address key gaps in the existing drill database and further strengthen the geological understanding of the A-Zone. LAURION is using this framework, together with ongoing drill results, to prioritize near-term drilling as it continues to systematically advance its exploration of the A-Zone , with the objective of validating its geological interpretation and supporting the evaluation of a potential maiden Mineral Resource Estimate (“MRE”). Additional targets, sequencing and timing remain subject to, among other things, ongoing results and available financing.

raw.title: Critical Metals Corp. Acquisition of European Lithium Approved by Supreme Court of Western Australia
raw.text: NEW YORK, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML) (“Critical Metals Corp” or the “Company”), a leading critical minerals exploration and mining company, today announced that the Supreme Court of Western Australia (the “Court”) has approved the Company's proposed acquisition of European Lithium Limited (ASX: EUR, FRA: PF8, OTC: EULIF) (“European Lithium”). Under the proposed transaction, Critical Metals Corp would acquire 100% of the issued share capital of European Lithium and all of European Lithium's listed options by way of Court-approved schemes of arrangement under Part 5.1 of the Australian Corporations Act 2001 (Cth), comprising a scheme between European Lithium and its shareholders (the “Share Scheme”) and a scheme between European Lithium and the holders of its listed options (ASX: EUROC) (the “Option Scheme”, and together with the Share Scheme, the “Schemes”).

raw.title: Lithium Argentina Announces Repurchase of $200 Million of its 2027 Convertible Notes
raw.text: ZUG, Switzerland, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG ("Lithium Argentina" or the "Company") (TSX: LAR) (NYSE: LAR) today announced that it has repurchased $200 million aggregate principal amount of its convertible senior notes due January 2027 (the "2027 Notes") in privately negotiated transactions with a limited number of qualified institutional buyers for approximately $198 million in cash, plus accrued interest. The repurchases were funded with cash on hand, including proceeds of the $180 million strategic investment from Ganfeng Lithium Group Co., Ltd.

raw.title: Li-FT Announces First Results from Summer Drill Program at the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project, Quebec
raw.text: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Li-FT Power Ltd. (“LIFT” or the “Company”) (TSXV: LIFT) (ASX: LFT) (OTCQX: LIFFF) (Frankfurt: WS0) is pleased to announce assay results from the first 5 of 45 drill holes from the Adina-Galinée Lithium Project (“AGLP”) in Québec, Canada (Figure 1). The 45 holes comprise 39 holes totaling 11,420.5 metres completed as part of LIFT's 2026 summer drilling program, together with 6 previously unreleased historical drill holes from 2024 (1,983 metres), totalling 13,403.5 metres of drill core. Holes ALP-0001 to ALP-0005C from the 2026 drill campaign are presented in this release. The intercepts for drill holes ALP-0001 to ALP-0005C are presented in Table 1 and shown in figures 2, 3 & 4, with a highlight of 56 meters of 1.43 % Li 2 O intersected in drillhole ALP002.

raw.text: MONTREAL, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- October 29, 2026 – Sydney, Australia Highlights The Government of Canada, through Natural Resources Canada's ("NRCan") First and Last Mile Fund ("FLMF"), has approved a contribution of C$1,215,185 for the Shaakichiuwaanaan access road project. raw.text: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 29, 2026) - Genesis Goldfields Corp. (CSE: GGF) (OTC: NEWDF) (FSE: M4K0) ("Genesis Goldfields" or the "Company") is pleased to announce a non-brokered private placement financing of up to 13,333,333 units in the capital of the Company (each, a "Unit") at a price of $0.15 per Unit, for gross proceeds of up to $2,000,000 (the "Offering"). Mr. Hill's 40-year career spans exploration through development and production on orogenic gold systems, much of it in Africa.

raw.title: New Age Metals Enters Due Diligence Period With Benton Resources Inc.
raw.text: October 27th, 2026 - TheNewswire – Rockport, Ontario – New Age Metals Inc. (“ NAM ” or the “ Company ”) (TSXV: NAM; OTCQB: NMTLF; FSE: P7J) is pleased to announce that it has entered into an option agreement with Benton Resources Inc. (TSXV:BEX) (“Benton”) dated June 24, 2026 as amended September 3, 2026 (the “Agreement”), whereby Benton has provided the Company a due diligence period until November 15, 2026 on the potential acquisition of a 100% interest in Benton's Abernethy Lake Gold Project, (to be renamed “Kenora Thunder Gold Project”) located approximately ten (10) kilometres from the City of Kenora in the Kenora Mining District, Northwestern Ontario. The Agreement provides the Company a due diligence period until November 15, 2026, to conduct investigations, consultations, meetings, review and assessments deemed necessary, including engaging with the applicable First Nations Chief and Council and other relevant Indigenous representatives, to determine whether sufficient support, access, approvals, permits and authorizations can be obtained to permit the continuation of the Company's option. Upon completion of the Company's review and prior to expiration of the due diligence period, the Company may deliver a notice to proceed (the “Notice”) with its option. A subsequent news release will be issued in the event the Company provides Benton with the Notice. The Notice would become the effective date of the Agreement. NAM is committed to working collaboratively with local First Nations to ensure responsible, sustainable exploration that respects community values and priorities.

raw.title: Tibooburra Project Update: RC drilling to commence as Novo forms unincorporated Joint Venture with Manhattan Gold
raw.text: HIGHLIGHTS Novo has now received all regulatory and land holder approvals required to commence a ~2,700 m RC program at Tibooburra, NSW, with drilling at the Clone prospect currently anticipated to commence in early-November 2026.  Step out drilling at the Clone prospect will target a northern extension to open, shallowly plunging, high-grade gold mineralisation confirmed during Novo's 2025 drill campaign that reported results up to 12 m @ 5.90 g/t Au from 16 m, including 5 m @ 13.74 g/t Au from 23 m in TBR0001.1   Regional streams and targeted soils, mapping and rock chip sampling commenced at Tibooburra in September 2026, with results pending and a further program being undertaken in October 2026.

raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire - October 26, 2026 – Opawica Explorations Inc. (the “Company” or “Opawica”) (TSXV: OPW) (OTCQB: OPWEF), announces a non-brokered private placement of up to $2,950,000 through the issuance of a combination of flow through common shares (the “FT Shares”) at a price of $0.17 per FT Share and non-flow through units (the “NFT Units”) at a price of $0.0.15 per NFT Unit (the “Offering”).   Each NFT Unit will be comprised of one common share and one-half of one common share purchase warrant (a “NFT Warrant”). Each whole NFT Warrant is exercisable to purchase one common share at a price of $0.30 per share for a period of two years from the date of the close of the Offering. If, at any time after four months and one day following the closing date of the Offering, the closing price of the Company's common shares on the TSX Venture Exchange (the “TSXV”) is equal to or greater than $0.40 per share for 10 consecutive trading days, the Company may, by notice to the holders of the NFT Warrants (which notice may be given by way of a general news release), accelerate the expiry date of the NFT Warrants to a date that is not less than 30 days following the date of such notice.

raw.text: Highlights Prescription formulary grows from 4 to 16 therapies in under 4 months since the Company's nationwide telehealth launch Seven therapy areas now covered: weight management, performance and growth hormone support, recovery, longevity and cellular health, immune support, cognitive health and sexual wellness Multi-therapy stacked protocols introduced, allowing clinicians to combine therapies into a single personalized program The Company's total portfolio now stands at 23 products across 3 formats: needle-free patches, oral and topical formulations, and clinician-prescribed therapies Every prescription is issued by a U.S.-licensed clinician, medications are compounded in the United States, and shipped to patients in all 50 states Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 29, 2026) - The Precision Peptide Company Inc. (CSE: BPC) (OTCQB: PNGAF) (the "Company" or "BPC"), a publicly traded wellness company focused on advanced peptide formulations and delivery systems, today announced that it has quadrupled its U.S. telehealth formulary to 16 prescription therapies across seven therapy areas, less than four months after launching nationwide telehealth access. raw.title: Pinnacle Prepares Plans for Drilling and Field Work to Follow Up on Polymetallic Discoveries at El Potrero
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA, October 29, 2026 – TheNewswire - (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that its geological team has put together a diamond drilling program to follow up on the silver-gold-lead-zinc mineralization discovered on the Maria Fernanda 2 (“MF2”) concession on the Potrero project in Durango, Mexico earlier this year (see Figures 1 and 2).  While permitting is underway on this drill program, detailed mapping and sampling will be conducted on the northern El Potrero claim block following up on the discovery of silver-rich veins with assays up to 1,159 g/t Ag (see Pinnacle news releases from March 17 and April 20, 2026 ) .   “The exciting discovery of high-grade gold-silver-lead-zinc mineralization earlier this year demonstrated the district scale potential of the Potrero Project ,” stated Robert Archer, Pinnacle's President & CEO.  “Having conducted extensive mapping and sampling on the MF2 concession, we now believe that this polymetallic mineralization is an extension of the Topia Mine system, only four kilometres to the southwest.  The polymetallic veins have a northeasterly trend, as at Topia, as opposed to the dominantly northwesterly trend of the gold-silver veins in the northern part of the Potrero property, and are believed to represent a completely different age of hydrothermal activity 1 .  The alteration, vein textures and elevation all point to the potential for the preservation of significant mineralization not far below surface at MF2.  The Phase I drill program will test this concept and, if successful, will lead to a larger drilling campaign of delineation drilling.  In addition, we look forward to following up on similar, silver-rich veins on the southern part of the Potrero block, roughly five kilometres from the MF2 mineralization.”

raw.title: Pinnacle Receives Permit for Surface Drilling Program at El Potrero and Provides Update on Other Permits for Production Restart
raw.text: VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - October 26, 2026 (TSXV: PINN, OTCQB: PSGCF, Frankfurt: P9J) – Pinnacle Silver and Gold Corp. (" Pinnacle " or the “ Company ") is pleased to announce that it has received a permit from the Secretaría del Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales ( SEMARNAT), Mexico's federal ministry responsible for environmental protection, natural resource management, and sustainable development , for a surface drilling program at the past-producing El Potrero gold-silver project in Durango, Mexico.  The permit covers 110 drill sites and is valid for two years.  At present Pinnacle is planning on a first-pass drill program contemplated to include 48 holes, for 5,540 metres.  Targets will include gaps around the historic mine workings that could not be reached by the current underground drilling program, the additional 1,100 metre strike extent of the Dos de Mayo vein system, the parallel El Capulín vein system and the Estrella vein (see Figure 1). Significantly, this permit is more than just a standard drill permit.  Due to the categorization of the area within which this part of the property lies as being classified as ‘Semi-warm, Sub-humid', the ‘NORMA 120' standard for drill permits does not apply.  Consequently, a full environmental permit, or Manifiesto Impacto Ambiental (MIA) was required.  In going through the protracted process of obtaining this permit, Pinnacle was required to provide substantively more background and baseline data than would normally be required for a drill permit, resulting in a longer approval time.  Having now done that however, the same data is being used to form the basis for the permits required for the mine, processing plant, tailings storage facility (TSF), powerline extension, water license, and auxiliary infrastructure, all of which are underway.

recentNews.title: Regency Silver to Exhibit at the 2026 New Orleans Investment Conference

raw.title: Regency Silver to Exhibit at the 2026 New Orleans Investment Conference
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - Regency Silver Corp. (TSXV: RSMX) (OTCQB: RSMXF) (FSE: ZJ90) ("Regency Silver" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it will be exhibiting at the 2026 New Orleans Investment Conference, taking place October 28 to 31, 2026, at the Hilton New Orleans Riverside, 2 Poydras Street, New Orleans, Louisiana. Now in its 50th year, the New Orleans Investment Conference is one of the longest-running and most widely attended resource investment events in North America, bringing together retail and institutional investors, newsletter writers, analysts and mining executives.

raw.text: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc has executed a dramatic turnaround, transforming from a 'burning platform' into a high-margin industrial leader with robust free cash flow. Guidance upgrades, a multi-year share buyback, and a strong net cash position support my reiterated buy rating, even after a tenfold share price rise since 2023. Future growth is underpinned by the UltraFan30 engine's potential reentry into the narrowbody market and continued strength across aerospace, defense, and power systems.

raw.title: CleanTech Provides Update on Robinson-Lasher Asset Sale Transaction
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. (TSXV: CTV) (OTCQB: CTVFF) ("CleanTech" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update with respect to the proposed sale of the Company's Robinson-Lasher zinc-germanium-gallium deposit (the "Robinson-Lasher Project") to Silver Elephant Mining Corp. ("Silver Elephant"), as previously disclosed in news releases dated June 12, 2026 and September 14, 2026 (the "Transaction"). Pursuant to the asset purchase agreement (the "Asset Purchase Agreement") entered into among the Company, Silver Elephant and U.S. Fluorspar LLC (the "Vendor" or "Subsidiary"), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, Silver Elephant is required to pay to the Company an aggregate of US$1,255,000 in a series of cash payments as partial consideration for the purchase of the Robinson-Lasher Project, ending on or before September 1, 2029.

raw.title: Silver Elephant Receives Approval to Proceed with Robinson-Lasher Asset Acquisition Transaction
raw.text: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 26, 2026) - Silver Elephant Mining Corp. (TSX: ELEF) (OTCQB: SILEF) (FSE: 1P2)  ("Silver Elephant" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update with respect to its proposed acquisition of the Robinson-Lasher zinc-germanium-gallium deposit (the "Robinson-Lasher Project") from CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. ("CleanTech") (the "Transaction"), as previously disclosed in the news release dated June 12, 2026. Pursuant to the asset purchase agreement (the "Asset Purchase Agreement") entered into among Silver Elephant, CleanTech and U.S. Fluorspar LLC (the "Vendor"), a wholly owned subsidiary of CleanTech, Silver Elephant is required to, among other things, (i) pay to CleanTech an aggregate of US$1,255,000 as partial consideration for the purchase of the Robinson-Lasher Project, which will be paid in a series of cash payments ending on or before September 1, 2029, and of which the first cash payment of US$85,000 was made on September 17, 2026; (ii) issue 6,300,000 common shares of Silver Elephant at a deemed price of $0.13 per share to CleanTech (the "Share Consideration"), which Share Consideration was issued on October 23, 2026 following the receipt of approval in respect of the Transaction from the Toronto Stock Exchange by Silver Elephant and from the TSX Venture Exchange by CleanTech; and (iii) commit a minimum of US$2,000,000 in exploration expenditures on the Robinson-Lasher Project and prepare an independent National Instrument 43-101 technical report.

raw.title: Sirios Resources Inc. Announces Results of Shareholder Meeting
raw.text: Montréal, Québec--(Newsfile Corp. - October 30, 2026) - Sirios Resources Inc. (TSXV: SOI) (OTCQB: SIREF) (FSE: 377A) ("Sirios" or "Company") is pleased to announce the voting results for its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held earlier today at 900, boulevard De Maisonneuve Ouest, Suite 1800, Montréal, Québec, H3A 0A8 (the "Meeting"). Shareholders voted in favour of all matters brought before the Meeting and all resolutions were duly passed, including: (i) the election of each of the seven nominated directors, being Dominique Doucet, Jean-Félix Lepage, Colinda Parent, Guy Le Bel, Robert Ménard, Sean Roosen, and Laurence Farmer; (ii) the reappointment of Raymond Chabot Grant Thornton LLP as the independent auditor of the Company for the ensuing year and the authorization for the board of directors to fix its remuneration; (iii) a special resolution authorizing the change of name of the Company from "Sirios Resources Inc." to "Sirios Mining Inc." and, in French, "Minière Sirios Inc." ("Name Change"); (iv) a special resolution authorizing a share consolidation on the basis of one (1) post-consolidation common share for every fifteen (15) pre-consolidation common shares ("Consolidation"); and (v) the Company's new 10% "rolling" omnibus equity incentive plan ("Omnibus Plan"), which provides for the grant of options, share units, and deferred share units.

raw.text: Orbital Engineering leads an expanded engineering consortium advancing engineering, permitting, procurement, construction, and operational readiness in Alexandria, Louisiana Halifax, Nova Scotia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 27, 2026) - Ucore Rare Metals Inc. (TSXV: UCU) (OTCQX: UURAF) ("Ucore" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has retained the services of Process Engineering Associates, LLC ("PEA") as its Owner's Engineering Representative, and to provide specialty process engineering support to the Orbital Engineering, Inc. ("Orbital") led Louisiana Strategic Metals Complex ("SMC") project's (the "Project") engineering consortium. The Company is also pleased to announce personnel additions across operations and project and construction management as the Project execution accelerates.

raw.title: Third Avenue Real Estate Value Fund Q3 2026 Portfolio Activity
raw.text: Valuations seemed much more favorable for international property companies, particularly in comparison to some of the larger U.S. companies involved with senior housing and data centers. Along these lines, the Fund initiated positions in the common stock of Scentre Group and Home Depot during the quarter. Third Avenue Real Estate Value Fund trimmed back WESCO and Freddie Mac preferred, exited D.R. Horton, and extended its British Pound and Hong Kong Dollar hedges for portfolio management purposes.
